research.title: Classification Baselines for Tabular Data with Missing Values
bullets: Prepared tabular classification data by checking label consistency, separating training and validation partitions, and fitting imputation procedures exclusively on training observations.
Implemented logistic regression and random forest baselines using specified preprocessing pipelines, comparing discrimination and calibration across alternative missing-value treatments.

projects.title: Ridge Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ordinary least squares and ridge regression baselines on synthetic datasets with correlated predictors, using consistent training and test partitions.
Selected regularization settings through cross-validation and examined coefficient stability alongside held-out prediction error under varying predictor correlations.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Baselines for Cluster Recovery
bullets: Implemented a standard Gaussian mixture clustering workflow on synthetic data, comparing covariance specifications under fixed preprocessing and initialization procedures.
Examined cluster assignments against generating labels and inspected convergence diagnostics to document sensitivity to initialization and overlapping component distributions.
